setup_env: setup the ManipTrans IsaacGym dexterous hand manipulation environment from a SPIDER config
step_env: step all parallel environments with residual control actions and a pre-trained base imitator
get_reward: compute the imitation reward and info dict for each environment using ManipTrans RL pipeline
get_terminate: return per-environment termination signals based on RL failure detection and NaN state
record_video: record an MP4 video by replaying a saved trajectory in a headless IsaacGym environment
